sources.datasetTitle: 大專校院各校科系別概況
sources.publisher: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Department of Statistics
sources.notes: The official annual dataset reports department or organizational-unit rows with student, full-time teacher, and previous-academic-year graduate counts. Since academic year 110, the teacher field includes teaching assistants. Empty qualification labels in year 114 are preserved as organizational-unit rows and are not presented as degree offerings.

sources.datasetTitle: 大專校院學雜費收費基準
sources.downloadUrl: https://udb.moe.edu.tw/download/udata/static_file/114/校1-2.日間學士班以下學費、雜費收費基準-以「學院」統計(111學年度起).csv
sources.publisher: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Department of Higher Education
sources.notes: The supplied CSV was verified byte-for-byte against official dataset 24726. Dataset 31445 is a different aggregate institution-overview dataset and must not be cited as tuition provenance. Values are TWD tuition-and-miscellaneous-fee bases by daytime study category. The official source does not state a semester or annual charge period, so the artifact does not infer one. Source-reported zero is retained separately and is never interpreted as free tuition.
